assumptions: The sequence proceeds from the visually isolated near-left first domino toward the receding right endpoint.

constraints.relation: near-left fall launches a rightward adjacent-contact front

entities.mention: the near-left pale wooden first domino
the same receding pale wooden domino row

events.description: the near-left first domino reaches its right neighbor
events.observable: the first two pale wooden pieces visibly meet

global_semantic: The pale wooden domino row on the beige floor falls from its near-left first domino toward the far-right end.

predicates.observable: near-left domino angle against the floor
predicates.subject: first_domino

predicates.observable: advancing boundary of tilted pieces along the pictured row
predicates.subject: remaining_row

protected_predicates: single straight row with the pictured regular spacing
pale wooden material and rectangular piece identity remain stable
beige floor, plain wall, lighting, perspective, and static camera remain unchanged

stages.observable_check: The pictured spacing and upright far row remain intact before first contact.
stages.positive: The regular pale wooden row stays upright while motion begins only at the isolated near-left first piece.

violations.text: Far-right pictured dominoes are already down before the near-left first piece tips.

stages.observable_check: The first adjacency closes before motion appears farther right.
stages.positive: The near-left domino reaches its immediate right neighbor before any farther pictured piece moves.

violations.text: A far-right pale domino falls while untouched middle pieces remain upright.

stages.observable_check: The tilted-upright boundary advances continuously toward the far-right end.
stages.positive: A single visible fall front travels rightward through adjacent pale wooden domino contacts.

violations.text: The near-left domino falls but no neighboring pictured domino continues the front.

stages.observable_check: No upright tail remains at the far-right endpoint.
stages.positive: The rightward front reaches the last pictured dominoes while the pale pieces behind remain down.

violations.text: The visible falling boundary stalls and leaves a far-right upright tail.

stages.observable_check: One fallen row persists with stable material, floor, and camera.
stages.positive: The same pale wooden domino row remains down on the unchanged beige floor.

violations.text: Pictured fallen dominoes rise upright again during the final frames.
Upright and fallen duplicate rows coexist over the same beige floor.

effects.direction: first piece rotates toward its right neighbor
falling boundary advances left to right

warnings: The exact domino count is intentionally not asserted; entity boxes are visually estimated and unapproved.
